_comment: Suggested names for the Quick NPC wizard, offered one at a time so the GM never has to stop and invent one. Presentation only — a placeholder in a text box the GM overwrites at will — which is why this is UI config under ui/ rather than game content under data/: nothing here is derived from the SRD and nothing in the rules layer reads it. Grouped only for readability; the wizard draws from all of them.
